item.title: Wild One Birthday Decorations, Jungle Animals Name Banner & Cake Topper Printable
item.description: Wild one birthday decorations you can print at home: a jungle animals name banner kit and a matching cake topper. Choose the letters for your child's name, print them on cardstock and cut along the edges. Giraffe, zebra, lion, elephant and monkey flags fill the gaps between words. One download covers the first birthday and every sibling's party after it. Tap to get the printable kit on Etsy.
